constraints: automaticDrag only applies to text fields/variables, combo boxes, and list boxes.
automaticDrop only applies to picture fields/variables, text, combo boxes, and list boxes.

params.name: draggable
params.description: True = object draggable in programmed mode.

params.name: automaticDrag
params.description: True = object draggable in automatic mode (text fields/variables, combo boxes, list boxes only).

params.name: droppable
params.description: True = object accepts drops in programmed mode.

params.name: automaticDrop
params.description: True = object accepts drops in automatic mode (picture fields/variables, text, combo boxes, list boxes only).

discriminatedBy.rule: When '*' is passed, object is an object name (Text) identifying the target by name; when '*' is omitted, object must be a direct Variable or Field reference.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Sets or dynamically modifies, for the current process, the programmed/automatic drag and drop options for the designated form object.
overloadMerges.note: Merged the leading-'*' dual signature into one overload with object as a Text/Variable,Field union discriminated by '*'.
